summary: Iter64 — Frontend retest of DriverTripSheet fixes. All 3 items from the review request PASS in a single browser session: (1) SlideToConfirm now remounts per stage via key={cfg.slideTestId} — all 4 slide gestures (slide-arrive-pickup, slide-start-dropoff, slide-arrive-dropoff, slide-deliver) fire correctly and drive the booking driver_assigned → arriving → picked_up → in_transit → delivered without any reload; final DB row for exp_trip_test_seed is status='delivered' and /api/driver/me/express-active returns null (per contract). (2) data-testid='trip-navigate-btn' is present in every one of the 4 stages (count=1 at each). (3) xRef regression: short tap on slide-arrive-pickup-thumb (dx≈15px) correctly does NOT advance the booking (DB stayed driver_assigned), and each full ≥80% slide fires exactly once (each stage advanced by exactly one status step). Screenshots show the 'Delivered!' success screen after the final slide and the 'Delivered — great job! 🎉' sonner toast.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The multi-stage slide walkthrough is now fully green in one session. If future changes touch SlideToConfirm or STAGE_CONFIG, re-run the same 4-stage walkthrough starting from seed_trip_flow.py; the key= prop and xRef are the two invariants to preserve.
rca of the issue: iter63's root cause (SlideToConfirm state retention) was resolved by adding key={cfg.slideTestId} on the <SlideToConfirm> element at line 687 of DriverTripSheet.jsx — this forces React to unmount+remount the component on every stage transition so `confirming`/`confirmed` reset. The xRef mirror of the x state ensures onUp reads the freshest drag distance even under fast pointer-up. Verified end-to-end: all 4 slides fire, booking status walks cleanly to delivered, and short taps still bounce back.
